summary: The server hashed a scope's Postgres rows (booleans, jsonb objects and scalars) while the client re-hashed the same rows read back from SQLite (1, JSON text, and a jsonb scalar in a TEXT column read back as text), so ownUser, ownProfile and clientConfig never read as in sync. Every sweep healed them with a refetch, sweeps ran back to back, and "New space" hung on "Opening…" in production. Fixed: both sides hash each value as the client's SQLite stores it, as text.
